summary: Engity's Bifröst is a customisable SSH server application designed for remote access environments. It provides administrative controls over user authorisation methods and allows you to configure how and where incoming user sessions are executed. Built using Go and Docker, it runs as a containerised service for managing infrastructure access.
goodFor: It suits technical teams who need fine-grained control over SSH authentication mechanisms and session execution environments beyond standard OpenSSH configurations.
watchOut: With a modest repository footprint and niche feature set, you may encounter a smaller community for troubleshooting compared to traditional SSH daemons.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based Go application, it typically requires persistent storage volumes for configuration and state data, alongside standard port mapping for SSH traffic.
